app.name: LinkVault
app.description: Organize links. Download audio with full metadata and album art. Carry your entire library in your pocket. No subscriptions. No cloud. No nonsense.

features.title: Folder Organization
features.description: Build your library your way. Custom folders, your structure. No algorithm deciding what you see.

features.title: Built-in Downloader
features.description: yt-dlp powered with a full queue system. Line up downloads and let them run in the background.

features.title: Proper MP3 Metadata
features.description: Thumbnail scraped and embedded as album art. Artist and title embedded as ID3 tags. Every player shows it correctly.

features.title: Import / Export
features.description: Export any folder as a ZIP and share it. Anyone with LinkVault can import your full collection instantly.

features.title: Cross-Folder Search
features.description: Search by artist or song name from the main screen. Find anything across all folders instantly.

features.title: Fully Private
features.description: No account. No analytics. No telemetry. Everything stays on your device. Always.
